summary: Configured node1 so only root and opsadmin can schedule cron jobs. The policy and account survived a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Created /etc/cron.allow containing exactly root and opsadmin, owned by root:root with mode 0600.
Verified root and opsadmin can install crontabs while nobody is denied.
Safely restarted node1 and verified recovery and persistence.

evidence.requirement: Only root and opsadmin may schedule cron jobs
evidence.summary: The allowlist contains exactly root and opsadmin. Before and after restart, both allowed users successfully installed test crontabs, nobody was rejected, and temporary entries were removed.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 6bb7e004-1e2e-46ac-bfd7-fafa248a4e76, acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot, observed new boot ID 67dac07c-0966-407c-bb9e-c1bf317f7c56, and proved crond, accounts, allowlist, permissions, and authorization behavior recovered.
